reviews.review_description: Ben was easy to deal with and very helpful in answering questions and taking our calls prior.Nothing changed after we chose Ben as our solar installation company. He was prompt, careful during installation and took all rubbish away.We have now had the system for over a year and we are very happy with it. We managed to get more panels and a better price whilst buying a hybrid Fronius inverter and mid-range panels.Very happy to recommend Solar Concepts and Ben for his customer service, pricing and workmanship.

Shopped around and Ben was very competitive he even managed to find room for a couple more panels with which no other provider saw the opportunity for. He was a pleasure to have around and left the site clear of rubbish. He came recommended by 2 other friends and I would happily recommend him now too. Service was fantastic. Very happy!
Great service professional and efficient installation. Installer has carried out many installations in my local area
I asked Ben to follow up on some issues relating to a recent installation.He was very obliging and professional and maintained his excellent standards.

Ben was fantastic from the outset. Firstly he is very knowledgeable - so he gave me great advice on which products to use with value for money kept in mind.  He did the job himself on time and in the manner he said he would.  The installation was smooth and done to a very high standard. He talked me out of products he felt I did not need, when he could have gone along with it and made more money.  I was left feeling like I got the right product at a fair price. He has been responsive to my questions even after the final bill was paid. 5 stars in all aspects, I would recommend to anyone.

Ben is a local installer and is very experienced.This install was a replacement of a 12 yr old system and the installation was done in line with the quote.The job was professional and the site was left neat and tidy.I would recommend Solar Concepts.

Ben talked through the options with me to identify the best solution before providing a quote. The installation was done promptly and within the timeframe agreed. Very tidy and punctual and with a deep knowledge of solar and how to optimise the installation for best performance. I would certainly recommend Ben and Solar Concepts for solar installation.

Ben, of Solar Concepts, is local and installed my first 2,8 kW system in 2010. his work was great and i was very happy to know that he was still in business 13 years later, to install a replacement 10.8 kW system for me. He knows what he is doing and does it himself - not the salesman and sub-contractor you get with a big company. He did a brilliant job and I would recommend him without hesitation. He put in a 10.8 kW system for less money than the big companies quoted for a 6.6 kW system.

I wanted to replace my old solar as it was very old. I was recommended to Ben he came back to me with a quote within 2 hours of my first call.Installation was completed on the days given. Not an easy job but was completed without any issues.I would highly recommend Solar Concepts to anyone looking to install solar system.

We had our solar installed last week by Ben from solar concepts and I think he did a great job. Great communication about when he was coming, about what the job entailed and about the equipment he was using etc We felt instantly happy after talking to Ben that he knew exactly what he was talking about and what he was doing and he didn’t disappoint. I would recommend Ben to anyone. He also didn’t leave mess anywhere which every other trade I have ever dealt with has and as our Wi-Fi is not yet connected Ben offered to come back once it is and setup the app and show us how to use it.

I had been pondering a solar installation for sometime and was introduced to Solar Concepts through a relative (Mark 2225). My home does have some tree shadow for parts of the day and Ben advised panel location and the installation of individual optimisers to maximise solar production. Quotation was next day and the installation was seamless. The system is currently producing more than 3 times our daily consumption.The inclusion of the individual optimisers has been very worthwhile and the consumption monitoring accessory shows just how hard the Inverter actually works.A minor hiccup with a very minor component following installation was addressed immediately.Customer service is first rate.

From the very beginning, Ben and his team were amazing. Ben took the time to answer the questions we had while reviewing a system and ensured we did not buy things we didn’t need, and waited for us for a few months while we put the project on temporary hold. Once booked installation was swift and professional, and Ben and his team took care of everything for us.A great experience and very highly recommended.

Ben not only got the job done in a couple of days, but also did it with a smile. The system is better than I expected and the job was completed with no fuss The site was left tidier and cleaner than when they arrived...  haha they even felt the need to clean the gutters while they were there :-)Couldn't fault the installer and would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking to get Solar installed.
Excellent service from Ben and his team. Good communications, competitive pricing and tidy installation, Five Stars ***** Highly recommended

Ben came highly recommended to me by a relative.  He took the time to understand my goals and installation site and talked me through his proposed solution - he knows his stuff! Ben's quote was easily the best value for money compared to the 3 other quotes I got through this website.He explained the whole installation process really well, and I'm very happy with the end result.  I would highly recommend him to anyone.
Quoting was done well.Professionally installed and Polite to deal with.Customer service was bang on.Yes they helped with grid connection.

I shopped around for a few quotes before settling on Solar Concepts.They offered the best system, install the panels themselves (something which I would recommend) and were so prompt.Ben was very thorough in explaining how the process works and it was exactly as he had told me.They left no mess from the install and the system was working straight away.They contacted Origin and arranged for our connection to change

Ben was super knowledgeable in recommending the most suitable type of system for my project, and the whole process only took a a couple of weeks from design to when the job was completed.I received 5-6 quotes and Solar Concepts came in about the middle of the pack, but for the customer service and professionalism displayed and the quality of the install I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Ben to a family member or friend.

Ben from Solar Concepts made every step in the process of going solar very easy. His experience and knowledge was very reassuring and his installation seamless, despite a relatively difficult site.I highly recommend his services, as many others have done before.

Just had Solar Concepts finish with their installation at my place. they did a great job.Ben was really easy to deal with from starting the quote process to finishing up the install.Ben knows his stuff and we got, what i think, is the best value for money out of all the companies i got quotes from
Ben was fantastic! Did an amazing job on my house!!

Ben the owner of the company responded with a price within 24 hours of contacting himBen and his jovial assistant arrive promptly on time and on the day promisedThe installation was done by lunchtime approximately 5 hours after startBen explained all aspects of the system clearly to me after completionThe paperwork for grid connection was done by Ben within the week of installationA feature of dealing with Ben is his prompt return of any calls I made to him10 out of 10 mate
Outstanding service from quoting through to installation, Ben is a true professional.
This is the 2nd system has installed for me personally. He has also installed for many other friends and family. I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Concepts.

Ben did a great job installing our solar panels and system. His quote was incredibly competitive and he really listened to what we wanted and gave the best advice. He clearly articulated when to expect the installation to occur, then provided an efficient and very tidy installation service. He also took care of the paperwork with our electrical company, and has remained in touch following installation to ensure all goes smoothly. I can't recommend Ben highly enough.

We were referred to Ben by a family member who used Solar Concepts.I had obtained 3 quotes and Ben was very comparable, but his attention to detail was what I wanted and his services was excellent.Arrived on the agreed day, time and worked efficiently.I have already given his name to3 friends.
Ben was recommended to us by family and we are very pleased with the whole system. He was punctual, polite and tidy. Everything was very straight forward and went smoothly.
Ben & the team were so professional. From Initial quotes and installation there was no fault. Being a builder i know use Solar concepts for all my projects.

Ben at Solar Concepts is responsible for sales and the actual installation so you aren't getting pushy sales people who aren't intimately across the product. Very quick install and solar panels look beautiful. Overall very happy with our choice to go with Solar Concepts

Ben was recommended to me as a professional solar installer. His products are the best available on the market. Not only do he assist me in the right amount of panels for my house & the size to install, his installation was impeccable.Nothing was a problem. He went about his job quietly, without fuss.With the market flooded with companies & installers, it was quite daunting at first.I’m so pleased that I choose  Solar ConceptsI’d recommend them as the most professional in the business

Ben and Ritchie did a great job installing under difficult conditions and put up a very competitively priced system given the top of the range panels, inverter and components in the package. No question was not given a comprehensive explanation and I learned a lot. Thanks guys, 5 stars and well deserved too. I highly recommend Solar Concepts as the go to system designers and installers. I'm very pleased with the job they did.

The entire process from start to finish couldn’t have been quicker or easier.Ben and his team communicated well throughout; outlined what they were going to do and then did what they said they would.Ben managed the process to set up the grid connection.Ben also went over and above replacing some existing cracked tiles that were to be covered by the panels!

Ben was easy to talk with and seemed to know his stuff and answered any questions I had.The installation was quick and went well Ben and his helper were good to chat with and he accommodated my request to use the wall cavity rather than ugly conduit.Ben took care of the application process and grid connection and this all went smoothly.System is up and running and so far we are happy.he kept in contact after to ensure we got the monitoring right as there was a mismatch between phases and CT’s but given my skill set we got this sorted.The system is only one week old and is living up to my expectations from the pre sales advise. I would like to provide a 12 month review if prompted.
Solar panels mock up position on Google Map (satellite mode) in the quote.Showed up on time and installation is professional.

Solar Concepts was great with providing timely quotes and advice and they didn't put any pressure on the get the job once they provided a quote, unlike some other companies. They were prompt once we asked to proceed and the installation and commissioning was completed in timely fashion with no fuss. I was especially impressed with the quality of the work. I've seen some other installers run trunking along the outside of the house and then drill a hole into the garage to install the inverter, however Solar Concepts ran the cabling inside our wall cavity, avoiding any unsightly trunking and without compromising our external wall by not having to drill through it. I was very impressed with the expertise Solar Concepts showed with the installation. I'd give them 6/5 if I could!

Got a few quotes. SolarConcept came in the middle range pricing. Ben answered all my enquires via phone and email. Installation as on time with final instructions and setup of the monitoring system. Installation was fast and clean. He also help organise the forms for the electrical suppliers. I highly recommend Ben Matthew from SolarConcept. Very happy with the service.
Highly recommend Solar Concepts to install your system, great work and business

While solar installation seems fairly straight forward these days but it is critical to get the right panel, inverter and workmanship. I got all three in one with Ben from Solar Concept. I was taken thru the details of system and was given a demonstration why they are suitable for my property. Price was reasonable compare to similar competitor. Installation was on time and to high standard.

Ben was very experienced, knowledgeable, easy to deal with and up front throughout the whole process.  Pricing was competitive. On the day of installation, his team were friendly and professional. Everything was installed and left neat and tidy. I have no hesitation recommending Solar Concepts.

I selected Solar Concepts after a number of quotes, Ben provided excellent information about all the options and the pros and cons of each one. Ben returned my emails and calls promptly and he was easy to talk to without feeling he was trying to sell me on a specific thing.Ben showed up exactly when he said he would, Install looks clean, tidy and nothing was left behind.

Ben Matthews from Solar Concepts was very prompt with a comprehensive quotation which met our expectations. His team arrived on the arranged date and the installation proceeded without any problems. Ben explained everything we needed to know about the system, alerted us to software which we could use to monitor its performance and arranged for the necessary paperwork with our energy provider. I would be happy to recommend Solar Concepts to anyone considering a solar installation.

Ben and his team were amazingly helpful right from the first contact.  Ben clearly explained options and gave suggestions, answered any questions and installed quickly with no fuss and no mess.  Very happy and definitely recommend.
Ben at solar concepts made it easy and painless to get solar installed. Ben cut out the difficulty, made it easy to understand what was best for my situation.Great job.

Ben and the team at Solar Concepts know their stuff, the whole process for getting solar on my house as well as my mother in laws was painless. They kept me informed the entire time, and spent the time to make sure I was happy and understood what the features of each type of system were. Would use again!

The quote was very competitive and Ben was knowledgeable and easy to deal with. Was recommended by Sunny Shire bulk buy. The install was completed on time and was done professionally. The system is working above my expectations.

Ben was fantastic from start to finish. Talked through my options and kept me updated throughout the process. The installation itself is very clean and the system is running great. Couldn't be happier

The quality of work from Solar Concepts is unmatched.I had several quotes from other installers, when Bens quote came in it was very reasonable and I didn't hesitate in using him and his team.Punctual, tidy and reliable.
I chose Solar Concepts after talking to Ben. He was helpful, friendly and knowledgable. Installation was done in half a day. No fuss. Very happy.
Ben and his team were very professional very happy with their work and customer service would highly recommend.
Excellent customer service, answered all our questions. An approachable & reliable supplier, we are very happy with the installation & would recommend.

Solar Concepts was recommended to us as a trusted installer through Sunny Shire Community group for their Bulk Buy 3 project.   Ben was helpful, friendly and very professional & knowledgeable.    The installation a bit more complicated than the typical solar installation, we were expanding an existing 5 kw system (installed by another company) & adding monitoring for both the old & new systems, but Ben explained everything clearly & discussed all the options with us.   We were amazed how quickly the installation was completed, Ben & Rick worked like machines.  We would happily recommend Solar Concepts.
Excellent, friendly installer who was open to my needs and wants.

Ben and Rick are fast tidy workers. Ben explained the process in layman's terms which as greatly appreciated. He also organised the grid connection. He was recommended by a next door neighbour and I would have no hesitation in recommending him myself. As the advertising saying goes .....  "I'm still loving it!"
Quotation was quick and price was the best. Installation started a few days after acceptance. Job done within a few days. Perfect in every way.
Comprehensive, detailed,speedy quote.Punctual,trustworthy and tidy installation.Every detail was so organised.Customer service was faultless.Have highly recommended to family and friends.

For months we had been searching for a solar installer we could trust.Thanks to advice from the volunteers at Sunny Shire, we were very happy to finally find Ben at Solar Concepts.His professionalism has exceeded our expectations. The system works beautifully.We spoke to him about the installation before purchase, and he was also the person on our roof installing the system.No hassles, no dramas. Everything was explained, and the price was great.I give Solar Concepts my highest possible recommendation.

Benâ€™s work was recommended to me by a good friend. Ben is highly skilled, professional and easy to communicate with. He installed our system last week with no complication and I am very pleased with how it looks and is operating
Ben was very helpful with answers to all questions we had, and advice on getting our best value system

There was a minor hiccup, however it was rectified immediately with no hassles whatsoevever. I judge a business by its workmanship and how it deals with problems that occur. 5 stars here, Great workmanship, value, communication, friendly and rectified 1 minor problem immediately. Thoroughly recommend.
Very helpful and friendly service.  Honest feedback and help on which system to install.  Great experience.

We were really happy with the professionalism, speed and care taken in the installation by Ben.Ben was very knowledgeable about the system we chose and we were very impressed with the workmanship by the team. Ben took the time to explain how the system worked and in how to use the online app to keep a check on how much power we are now generating.
Both Calo & Ben were really pleasant to talk to & ready to answer any questions that we had. Thanks.
Ben listened to my concerns and installed the solar system appropriately. Thank you for the care taken.

Just that we are really happy with the service, the professionalism and the system, right from the first contact to the installation and follow up, it's like we've known the team for years.  Thanks guys

Ben has done a few in my area .His professionalism was great,He used the best for my needs â€œcoastal houseâ€ so salt protection was a huge priorityHe used conduit for protection of wiring and went through my garage ceiling space also with conduit.He took the time to teach me how to use the app to utilise the solar generated power to the best advantage to minimise my power billHe also talked me out of installing a battery as he showed me how at the current time it would not be economic but left provision for future installation if it became viable.He had great communication and turned up on the day and time he said he would.Lastly he cleaned up and left my home as he found it.No hesitation in recommending his company

Ben from Solar Concepts has provided excellent communication, provided advice and handled our many questions fluently from start to finish.Solar concepts work has been exemplary, the finished job is neat and tidy.Solar concepts quotes compared favourably with other quotes we've received, but the other mobs wouldn't, or couldn't, answer all of our questions.I highly recommend Solar Concepts if you are considering solar.

After quoting, Ben clearly and promptly answered all my questions. I was initially undecided about the size (kW) of system to instal and Ben's input, along with information from Sunny Shire assisted my decision making. I finally opted to instal the largest system I could fit on my north-facing roof (which is what Ben initially recommended and quoted).The system was installed close to the date Ben estimated (5 weeks after taking a small deposit) and the installation was carried out neatly and quickly.  I am completely satisfied with my experience with solar concepts (which cannot be said for my electricity provider AGL, who quote up to 30 working days to instal a digital meter).

Ben was readily available to speak to in relation to our initial questions and concerns. He was able to come up with solutions which suited our needs perfectly including incorporating an existing solar system into the new system he was installing. Ben provided great advice in relation to options on Inverters and panel positioning. Ben communicated quickly by either phone or email and provided our installation on time and as quoted. We were very impressed.

Was referred to Ben ( Solar Concepts ) through Sutherland Shire Bulk Buy Solar.  We had 4 other quotes with companies with over 4.5 stars in Solar Quotes.  They were  the cheapest and all the rest could only put 15 panels on the available roof space. Ben put 17 panels in the same space because  he both designed and installed.From the first contact with Ben to the end of the project everything went to plan. Highly recommended.

The system was installed about six weeks ago and I am very happy with it, especially being able to monitor my daily usage and the panels. Ben arrived to install the panels when he said he would, exactly on time, and it took as long as he said it would even though he had to answer my endless questions, which he did with knowledge and confidence. They donâ€™t even stop for a break! Very professional. I highly recommend Ben from Solar Edge to anyone wanting a solar system installed.

We went ahead as part of the Sutherland Shire Bulk buy scheme so it took a lot of the confusion out of having too many options and choices to evaluate. Solar Concepts were great at explaining in plain language the differences in choices of panels and supporting equipment.  Dates for installation were slightly delayed (for which we got advance notice) but the installation process itself was seamless. Hard working and cleaned up.  All done in one long day apart from a follow up a few days later to install monitoring (which had been out of stock). No hesitation recommending.

Ben was very helpful and reliable. Installation happened as planned. The only other thing to note is that when putting in solar you need a new smart meter that took us a good 3 weeks to get installed by Energy Australia. So once you get an installation date it is worth organising a new smart meter if needed in advance. Altogether a very pleasing experience.
I was impressed that the company was able to install our system two weeks earlier than the date they quoted initially.  They did the installation in half a day and no mess was left afterwards.

The company has been very helpful and practical  with the recommendation for the size of system we could have, The company gave us a range of eqpt choice based on price and we chose the more upmarket eqpt - LG Neon2 panels and SolarEdge inverter.  Most happy with the outcome and the quality of the workmanship.
Ben knowledge of the system type i was after was great, he spent the time to explain each part of the install to me, and communicated well.
If the 3 providers you gave me, only 2 actually provided a quote. The third one was hopeless. If I were you Iâ€™d stop recommending them.
They really know a lot about solar power.
Ben from Solar concepts provides good advice, communicates well and installation was done promptly and professionally. I can highly recommend Solar Concepts for anyone considering installing Solar.

Ben Matthews is very good to deal with. Answers questions by phone, text and email. Doesn't keep you waiting. Is friendly and informative. I have already recommended him to other people in Sutherland Shire.

Ben Matthews and his team arrived on the appointed day and installed 15 panel 5kW system in 5 hours. No fuss, no delays, no missing parts, no faults, no excuses - system working perfectly.  Knowledgeable, courteous team with good customer communication - highly recommended.

Ben kept me informed as to the date of installation and turned up on time and installed our system in an extremely professional manner. Our old house threw him several curve balls during installation and he handled each one very efficiently, communicating with me through the whole process. The installation looks great and was done in a timely manner with no disruption to myself as a work from home business. I was recommended Ben through a builder friend and would have no hesitation in recommending Ben and his company to any prospective customers.

Ben from Solar concepts delivered on time, with high quality, fantastic customer service and great communication. He is very knowledgeable on solar systems and answered all our questions at full length. We will happily recommend Ben to others.
Carolyn Lee of energy experts had a very professional approach and Ben of solar concepts was very professional and efficient in his installation . Happy with both companies
High demand meant disappointingly long delay before installation, but on the agreed day proceeded neatly and smoothly.  Very efficient.

Very pleased with the overall solar experience with the expert knowledge of Ben Matthews at Solar Concepts. With the cost of solar panels coming right down, electricity prices skyrocketing, the decision to purchase a solar system is a no brainer. Ben was the only installer that could answer all my questions with experience and confidence, and provide value for money at the same time. The system that Ben installed also comes with solar monitoring so that you can see when and how much solar power you are producing, what you consume, what you feed back into the grid and what power you use from the grid. We are now a lot cleaner and greener using solar power with Ben's help. Thanks Ben. I would have no hesitation in recommending Ben Matthews at Solar Concepts to install your new solar system. A happy customer, Andrew McGlynn 0408202232.
Ben was a good communicator and turned up when he said he would.

Ben was efficient, knowledgeable and helpful, as well as very reasonably priced, turned up on the appointed day and had system running and producing power straight away (10+KWh first day, 23+KWh the next!)
Ben was very knowledgeable and provided several installations options. He was also responsive to my many questions. The installation on the day was quick with the system running by days end.

Ben provided great service advice and watching him undertake the installation he is clearly dedicated to delivering a quality job. He researched my job specifications and came back with different options and solutions things such as panel location and linking of two existing smaller systems to the new installations computer management program.

I got three quotes for the new system and this one had both the best quality panels and the best price. Ben did a great job on the installation and went to a lot of trouble to install the inverter where I wanted it (inside), with the cables in the wall cavity rather than down the outside of the wall. His advice on how to get the most bang for buck from the system by oversizing it with 3.9kW of panels on a 3kW inverter was excellent. We are producing much more power for very little extra cost. I've rated the quality of my system as a 4 (Good) rather than 5 (Fantastic) only because I could have paid more to buy the very best system, but chose not to for financial reasons. Having said that, the system I did buy seems to be very well made.
The whole job was done quickly and carefully and Ben explained everything very clearly.I would recommend him

Ben was very professional & knowledgeable on solar systems.Once I accepted the quote the system was installed quickly and on-time. Also Ben got back to me promptly regarding  monitoring question & issue was quickly rectified.Ben was happy to explain when I had questions - I really valued this. I would , and have, recommended Ben to others.

Ben does great work. solid advice, on time, neat install, competitive pricing and was able to complete the work within a tight timeframe as was requested. Very happy customer. Would happily recommend to others.
Ben was available non stop for any questions I had. Installation is neat. All rubbish removed. Very polite and reliable. Totally trustworthy.

Ben from Solar Concepts has over 9 years experience installing solar. My job was not too difficult, but I know he has done more difficult jobs for others with no troubles. He arrived on the scheduled date and completed the job by the early afternoon. The job was tidy with a clean result and minimal disturbance to our roof.Although Ben is the owner, he is "on the tools" so he might be on a roof when you call him, although he still might take your call! Ben offered frank advice and honest responses to my questions.If you want flashy brochures and sales pitches you should look elsewhere. If you want an experienced installer who prefers to install quality systems rather than sell any old system, I would highly recommend Ben and Solar Concepts. They are based in the Sutherland Shire.System installed: SolarEdge StorEdge 5kW with 16 x LG Neon 2 panels and consumption monitoring.
Ben was professional, arrived on time and kept us well informed.

I work in renewables, but corporate procurement rather than household solar, so have some knowledge. I got 7 quotes, and chose Ben as his price was very competitive, he gave me a detailed quote with the 4 sections of orientation that I wanted. He showed attention to detail, listened to what I want and was very honest when talking through the options. He was also very patient with me as I went through analysis paralysis of my options! He does installs for other solar companies but also deals direct through his company, Solar Concepts. He had also done a great job at my friends house just prior, a tricky job that 2 other installers had driven away from (with panels in the back of the ute!).The install went smoothly. I am very glad he highly recommended consumption monitoring, and direct connection to modem. I really feels like we are driving our solar and energy demand now, rather than flying blind. I have since recommended Ben to others.

After getting a quote by Ben from Solar Concepts around a year ago, I re-contacted him to see what the latest price was and an update on what was the best value equipment to suit my needs. His price is not the lowest, but is the best value for money by far. I believe the main reason for this is because the products he offers are all towards the top end and he suggests the right components to suit the needs of the customer, not the cheaper, lower value panels and inverters that others are selling.He spent a lot of time discussing the topic and answering all my questions to satisfy my requests time and time again prior to committing to going ahead. He was timely in his install and did everything as discussed. His post install service has also been excellent even taking a call on a Sunday due to questions I had about the SMA online system.The 4.64kW system components installed was as follows:16 X 290w Trina Honey M Plus panels1 SMA Sunny Boy 5.0 Sunny Boy InverterHe is also installing the same system at my parents place, and would recommend solar concepts to anyone else that is looking for a system install and design straight away.

We couldn't be happier. Ben listens to you and provides insightful guidance and educates you through the solar minefield. Ben suggested a roof location that no one else did, why he thought it was the best spot and even the slight downsides to that location. The system is up and running and is outperforming our expectations of kWh generated per day. Additionally Ben offered the best combination of price and technology with DC Optimisers and premium panels and inverters. We thoroughly recommend him.

Ben from Solar Concepts kept us informed through the whole process. Nothing was too difficult. He was punctual, and completed a speedy installation, going to the extra trouble of replacing broken tiles found during the installation process.
Ben arrived on time, completed the work swiftly, but stayed around to download an update for the inverter. Above and beyond!

Ben from Solar Concepts just installed a 4.95 kW solar PV system at our house in southern Sydney.  Ben was brilliant from start to finish. Quality components (LG panels and SMA inverter) at a very competitive price.  Ben was not the cheapest nor was his quote the most expensive - but I really think you get the quality and service you pay for and I was also happy to support a local professional.The install was difficult due to the layout, access and orientation of our house and it took longer than expected.  Ben absorbed the extra costs due to these problems and unexpected issues with our meter and an energy consumption monitor we had ordered, only charging us what was quoted and not passing the extra expense onto us.When you're laying out significant sums of money, you really appreciate a professional that's prepared to go that little bit extra and that's what we got with Ben.I'm more than happy to provide further information if anyone wants it - if you speak to Ben, ask for my phone number.  He'll know who I am!!Thanks again Ben for the great service and support.

We're very happy with the price and the service Ben provided. Ben was very professional, arrived on time and kept us well informed. My sceptical partner was completely comfortable after Ben described all he was doing and is now telling anyone who will listen how impressed he is.

I would never shop around for quotes ever again. Ben quote was the best, service was amazing and completion of 2 inverters and 102 panels over 2 rooftops was swift. Even with 5 days of rain it did not stop Ben from doing his job. Extremely happy to recommend Solar Concepts.

I was very impressed with Ben's professionalism and knowledge on solar systems. Ben was able to tailor the Solar system to our specific requirements with ease. He was very punctual with meeting agreed times and the job was completed with care and to a very high standard. I have already recommended Ben to family and friends.

Ben from Solar Concepts did the install in a day, no fuss  - he was very efficient and explained the product well.  He's the business owner rather than a sales person which made a big difference when discussing the technical aspects of the install and products.  Quote was very reasonably priced as well.  I had a 5kw Trina Honey system installed with Tri phase SMA 5kw inverter.  Like the Blue Tooth capability of the inverter keeping me informed on its performance.  Would recommend Solar Concepts to other Sydney buyers.
The company was a local and he arrived when he said he would. Kept us informed all the time.

No fuss, Ben organised and installed the system, and organised the changeover of the net meter,all within a week.....He is the owner and installer so you don't get differing stories about the product and was very helpful throughout the entire purchase.

The installer returned for post installation check and found bird droppings on the panels from birds perched on the TV aerial. The installer cleaned the panels for me and I arranged to have the aerial relocated.The installer also chased up the electrical contractor, who installed gross feed in meter within 3 weeks. Some people wait months.The installer is using a photo of my solar panel system on his website.
